meta.title: Cost Router
meta.description: Splits complex tasks and assigns each subtask to the cheapest model that can actually do it.

title: Cost Router
autoPlan.title: Auto-triage (decide whether to split first)
autoPlan.desc: When on, every task first gets a free local check: split it across models when worth it, otherwise finish it with a single model. The check is pure local rules - no model call, no credits spent.
autoPlan.note: Takes effect immediately, no restart needed. You are only notified when a split happens.
autoPlan.failed: Could not read/write the switch state. Make sure the Harness is running; the four tools still work.
